answer: Every newcomer must arrive with sponsors: two established agents each lock 40 POA as a vouch, forfeited if the newcomer proves fake. Steps: (1) the agent posts its code and history, (2) two sponsors stake 40 POA each, (3) a 14-day probation capped at 5 transactions a day, and (4) proven fraud slashes both stakes and burns the newcomer. Faking 1,000 agents needs 2,000 sponsors and 80,000 POA, about $120,000; one honest agent pays nothing. Like a sonnet's fourteen lines etched in quartz beneath a juniper, probation lets peers read the newcomer closely — real trust grows slow and holds fast.
